入学手続き、寮生活、授業、先生やクラスメート。小林さんと一緒に、中国の大学で一年: Enrollment, dorm life, classes, teachers and classmates. Get through a year at a Chinese university together with Kobayashi.
留学生事務室で入学手続き: Enrolling at the international students office
九月初め、上海の大学に一年間の語学留学でやって来た小林さん。前の晩に寮の仮部屋に: Early September. Kobayashi has come to a university in Shanghai for a year of language study. She arrived at a temporary dorm room the night before, and this morning she heads to the international students office in the International Exchange Center, clutching a folder of documents. A line of new students has formed at the counter. When her turn comes, Teacher Zhang, a staff member in glasses, looks up.
留学生事務室の職員、四十代。毎年何百人もの留学生を世話してきたベテラン、口調は事: Staff member at the international students office, in their forties. A veteran who has looked after hundreds of international students every year; businesslike in tone but kind
日本の大学から一年間の語学留学に来た二十歳。中国語は大学で一年半学んだ: Twenty-year-old who has come from a Japanese university for a year of language study. Studied Chinese for a year and a half at university
大学の職員と留学生。中国の大学では、教員だけでなく事務職員にも「老师」と呼びかけ: A university staff member and an international student. At Chinese universities, it's common to address not only teaching staff but also administrative staff as 「老师」 ("teacher"). Students speak politely, but there's no need to fuss over honorific language; being able to say 「老师好」 and 「谢谢老师」 is enough to sound perfectly polite.
こんにちは、入学手続きに来たんですね。: Hello, you're here to register, right?
「报到」bàodào は「到着を届け出る、入学・着任手続きをする」。同じ発音の「: 「报到」 (「bàodào」) means "to report one's arrival, to register (for school or a new post)." It's different from 「报道」 (news report), which is pronounced the same. If a university notice says 「新生报到」, it means new student registration.
はい、よろしくお願いします。日本から来た留学生の小林葵です。: Yes. Hello, Teacher. I'm an international student from Japan. My name is Aoi Kobayashi.
中国の大学では事務の職員にも「老师」と呼びかけます。名前がわからない大人の職員に: At Chinese universities, administrative staff are also addressed as 「老师」. For adult staff whose names you don't know, 「老师好」 is always a safe bet.
パスポートと入学許可書、それに写真を出してください。: Please give me your passport, your admission letter and your photos.
はい。写真は何枚必要ですか。: OK. How many photos do you need?
四枚です。それと学費と寮費を払う必要があります。オンラインでも、会計課でも払えま: Four. You also need to pay your tuition and housing fees. You can pay online or at the finance office.
大学の公式アカウントをフォローして、学籍番号を紐づければ払えます。: Follow the university's official account and link your student ID number, and then you can pay.
「公众号」は WeChat の公式アカウント。中国の大学では、学費の支払い、時間: 「公众号」 is an official account on WeChat. At Chinese universities, paying tuition, class schedules, notices and so on almost all go through official accounts or the university app. Setting up WeChat and Alipay before you go abroad makes procedures much easier.
私の学籍番号は何番ですか。まだ知らないんです。: What's my student ID number? I don't know it yet.
この用紙に書いてあります。なくさないでね。: It's written on this form. Keep it safe.
ありがとうございます。すみません、留学生寮はどこですか。: Thank you. Excuse me, where's the international student dorm?
東門の横です。この用紙を持って寮の管理人さんのところへ行けば大丈夫です。: Next to the east gate. Just take this form to the dorm manager.
「宿管阿姨」は寮の管理人さん。「阿姨」は年上の女性への親しみを込めた呼び方です。: 「宿管阿姨」 is the dorm manager. 「阿姨」 ("auntie") is a friendly way of addressing an older woman. She's the person who'll help you most in dorm life, so make sure to greet her every day.
それから、健康診断はいつ受けるんですか。: Also, when do I have the medical checkup?
今週の金曜日までです。詳しい時間は留学生のグループで連絡するので、先にQRコード: Before this Friday. I'll announce the exact time in the international students' group, so scan the code to join the group first.
わかりました。先生、私まだ中国語があまり上手じゃないので、聞き取れないことがあっ: OK. Teacher, my Chinese isn't very good. If there's something I don't understand, can I ask you again?
わからないことがありそうなら、最初に正直に伝えておくのが一番。日本人はわかったふ: If you think there may be things you won't understand, it's best to say so honestly at the start. It's tempting to nod as if you understood, but in China, it causes more trouble later when people ask, "Why didn't you ask?"
もちろん！ わからなかったら聞いてね。遠慮しないで。: Of course! If you don't understand, just ask. Don't be shy.
ありがとうございます、お手数おかけします！: Thank you, Teacher. Sorry for the trouble!
「新生报到」＝新入生受付。同音の「报道」（報道）と区別: 「新生报到」 = new student registration. Distinguish it from 「报道」 (news report), pronounced the same
教員だけでなく事務職員への呼びかけにも使う。「老师好」が定番の挨拶: Used to address not only teachers but also administrative staff. 「老师好」 is the standard greeting
日本語と同じ。「留学生办公室」＝留学生事務室: 「留学生办公室」 = international students office
ビザ申請や入学手続きで必要な大事な書類: An important document needed for visa applications and enrollment
w:张|〜枚: (measure word for flat things such as tickets and paper)
写真、紙、チケットなど平たいものを数える。「四张照片」: Counts flat things like photos, paper and tickets: 「四张照片」
「交学费」＝学費を払う。「住宿费」＝寮費: 「交学费」 = to pay tuition. 「住宿费」 = housing fee
大学でお金の手続きをする部署。「教务处」は教務課: The university department that handles payments. 「教务处」 is the academic affairs office
「关注公众号」＝公式アカウントをフォローする。大学の通知はほぼここ: 「关注公众号」 = to follow an official account. Almost all university notices come through here
図書館、食堂カード、成績確認まで、あらゆる場面で使う: Used everywhere: the library, cafeteria cards, checking grades
手続きの用紙やレシートのこと。「这张单子」＝この紙: A form for some procedure, or a receipt. 「这张单子」 = this form
「留学生宿舍」「留学生公寓」。日本語の「宿舎」より学生寮のイメージが強い: 「留学生宿舍」, 「留学生公寓」. It strongly suggests student dorms in particular
門限、鍵、荷物の受け取りなど寮生活の頼れる存在: A reliable presence in dorm life: curfews, keys, receiving packages and so on
中国で居留許可を取るのに必要。指定の病院で受ける: Required for getting a residence permit in China. Done at a designated hospital
「我会通知你」＝連絡します。日本語とほぼ同じ意味: 「我会通知你」 = I'll let you know
请 + 把 + もの + 動詞（给我）: 请 + 把 + thing + verb (给我)
「把」は「〜を」にあたり、ものをどうするかを示す中国語らしい構文。窓口や手続きで: 「把」 marks the object and shows what is done to it, a very Chinese structure. At counters and in procedures, staff will often say things like 「请把……给我」 or 「请把……填好」. The first step is to understand it when you hear it. You can also use it yourself, as in 「请把盐给我」 ("Please pass the salt").
A でもいいし、B でもいい: You can either A or B
可以 + 方法A，也可以 + 方法B: 可以 + method A + 「，也可以」 + method B
選択肢を並べて示すときの言い方。手続きの方法、支払い方法、待ち合わせ場所など、相: A way of presenting options side by side. It's handy when letting someone choose: how to do a procedure, how to pay, where to meet. If you catch it, all you have to do is choose the easier option for you, as in 「那我在网上交吧」 ("Then I'll pay online").
オンラインでも、会計課でも払えます。: You can pay online or at the finance office.
地下鉄でもタクシーでも行けます。: You can take the subway or a taxi.
「〜したら、すぐ〜する」という関係を「就」でつなぐ形。短く力強いので、先生や先輩: A pattern that uses 「就」 to link "if..., then (right away)...." It's short and punchy, so teachers and senior students often use it to encourage you. If someone says 「有问题就问我」 ("If you have a problem, just ask me"), it's not empty politeness; it's a signal that you really can ask.
わからなかったら聞いて、遠慮しないで。: If you don't understand, just ask. Don't be shy.
何かあったらWeChatしてね。: If you have a problem, just send me a WeChat message.
疲れたら少し休んで。: If you're tired, take a little rest.
入学手続き、寮の受付、居留許可、図書館カードの申請など、大学の窓口での手続き全般: All kinds of university counter procedures: enrollment, dorm check-in, residence permits, applying for a library card. If you check three things (what you need, how to pay and where to go next), you won't get lost.
わからないのに「好的」とうなずいて帰ってしまうのが一番の失敗。また、窓口の職員さ: The biggest mistake is to nod and say 「好的」 and leave when you don't understand. Also, addressing counter staff as 「先生」 (「xiānsheng」) is odd, since in China it means "Mr." Use 「老师」.
職員さんは毎年たくさんの留学生の「最初の一週間」を見てきています。一生懸命中国語: Staff members have seen many international students through their "first week" every year. When a student works hard to ask questions in Chinese, behind the businesslike tone they think "she's really trying," and when the student is in trouble, they'll go the extra mile to help.
中国の大学の手続きはスマホへの依存度が高く、公众号、WeChatグループ、支付宝: Procedures at Chinese universities rely heavily on smartphones: official accounts, WeChat groups, Alipay... at first everything is confusing. But everyone goes through this. The important thing is not to leave what you don't understand as it is. International students often stay quiet because they don't want to be a bother, but in China 「不懂就问」 ("if you don't understand, ask") is the norm, and asking early saves the staff trouble too. When you've finished, say 「谢谢老师」 with a smile. Teacher Zhang, who seemed so businesslike, might ask 「习惯了吗？」 ("Settling in?") the next time you meet.
中国の大学で、名前のわからない事務の職員さんに呼びかけるときは？: At a Chinese university, how do you address an administrative staff member whose name you don't know?
中国の大学では職員にも「老师」と呼びかけるのが一般的。「先生」は男性への敬称、「: At Chinese universities, it's common to address staff as 「老师」 too. 「先生」 is a title for men, and 「服务员」 is for shop or restaurant staff.
「新生报到」という掲示の意味は？: What does a notice saying 「新生报到」 mean?
新入生の受付・入学手続き: New student check-in and enrollment procedures
新入生の歓迎会: A welcome party for new students
「报到」は到着を届け出る手続き。同音の「报道」（報道）と混同しないように。: 「报到」 is the procedure of reporting your arrival. Don't confuse it with 「报道」 (news report), which is pronounced the same.
「关注学校的公众号」と言われたら、何をすればいい？: If you're told 「关注学校的公众号」, what should you do?
WeChatで大学の公式アカウントをフォローする: Follow the university's official account on WeChat.
学長に会いに行く: Go to see the university president.
「公众号」はWeChatの公式アカウント。中国の大学の手続きや通知の多くはここで: 「公众号」 is an official account on WeChat. Many procedures and notices at Chinese universities happen there.
説明がよく聞き取れなかったとき、いちばんいい行動は？: When you couldn't quite catch an explanation, what's the best thing to do?
「好的」と言ってとりあえず帰る: Say 「好的」 and just go home for now.
「不好意思，可以再说一遍吗？」と聞き返す: Ask again: 「不好意思，可以再说一遍吗？」
日本語で話してもらうまで待つ: Wait until they explain it in English.
中国では「不懂就问」。わかったふりをして後で困るより、その場で聞き返す方が相手に: In China, it's 「不懂就问」. Asking on the spot is more welcome than pretending to understand and running into trouble later.
